## Checklist

- [ ] I looked at the contributing guide (`docs/development/contributing.rst`)
- [ ] I made sure this was not a duplicate PR (or clearly explain why it's better if it is)
- [ ] Tests pass locally (some combination of `tox`, `tox -e fix`, `tox -e type`, `tox -e docs`, depending on the
  change)
- [ ] The PR description is not significantly longer than the change not counting tests (use `<details>` tags if you
  really need more)
